question: Does the uncertainty inflation attributed to non-independent route stops persist when dependence is allowed across years within routes and when the same comparison is repeated within individual species?
population: Exactly the 2,835 weather-eligible strictly-prior-history pairs used in v0.1.

pooled_extension.model: Same v0.1 stop-level binomial GLM and identical risk set.
pooled_extension.new_covariance: Cluster sandwich by State x RouteNumber across all pairs, years, taxa and stops within a route.
pooled_extension.purpose: Allow both within-night and repeated-route dependence rather than stopping at pair-level clustering.

specieswise_extension.risk_set: For each species separately, cells with no recorded call at that stop in the drier member; response is wet calling-positive status.
specieswise_extension.formula: wet_activation ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)
covariances: cluster by focal matched pair (up to ten stops)
outputs: number of eligible and estimable species
median and IQR pair-cluster/IID SE ratio
median and IQR route-cluster/IID SE ratio
fraction of species with ratio > 1 for each clustered covariance
species-level ratios and coefficients for audit

interpretation.broad_support: Median clustered/IID SE ratio > 1 and more than half of estimable species have ratio > 1.
interpretation.boundary: This remains a representative acoustic-activation regression, not the exact published NAAMP occupancy-trend estimator; no universal claim over all monitoring models.

provenance: Post-hoc after explicit 2026-10-03 reopening. No eligibility threshold, formula or clustering definition may be changed after these outputs are read.
